title: Arbitration and Conciliation Act s. 66 — Statutory provision (ACA s. 66)

content.overview: Section 66 — Conciliator not bound by certain enactments belongs to the former conciliation regime in Part III of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996. The detailed conciliation provisions were superseded by the Mediation Act, 2023. This file is retained for historical/transition reference and must not be presented as the current general conciliation procedure.
